subject: microbiology
title: Actinomyces israelii, Sulfur Granules and Actinomycosis

steps.tx: **Actinomyces israelii** is a branching filamentous gram positive anaerobe (fungus mimic by name, bacterium by wall), oral and gut commensal invading after mucosal breach into cervicofacial actinomycosis: indurated lumpy jaw, sinus tracts discharging **sulfur granules**, fibrosis crossing tissue planes, dental caries and poor dentition behind most cases, penicillin for months the cure.
steps.say: Lumpy jaw with yellow granules in the pus plus bad teeth: actinomycosis until excluded.

vis.caption: Cervicofacial actinomycosis pathology, sinus tracts and sulfur granules.

steps.tx: **Sulfur granules** are not sulfur but bacterial microcolonies (yellow grains of Actinomyces filaments with clubbed Splendore Hoeppli protein coats), crushed between slides showing gram positive branching filaments, also mimicked by Nocardia, Streptomyces and botryomycosis grains, so microbiology must read the grain, not admire its colour.
steps.say: Crush the granule and stain it; colour alone has four authors.

right.title: Granule mimics
points: Streptomyces and fungi in eumycetoma (histology separates)
Sulfur named for colour, not chemistry

steps.tx: **Actinomycosis territories** map mucosal reservoirs: cervicofacial (dental), thoracic (aspiration, oesophageal breach, chest wall sinuses), abdominopelvic (appendix and bowel, intrauterine devices classically with pelvic masses mimicking malignancy), and disseminated rare. Every territory grows slowly and fibroses impressively enough to be biopsied for cancer first.
steps.say: A pelvic mass on an old IUCD that proves granules saves a woman radical surgery.

left.title: Territory clues
points: Pelvic: long retained IUCD, tubo ovarian mass

right.title: Behaviour rules
points: Malignancy mimic by mass and weight loss

steps.tx: **Actinomyces therapy** is prolonged penicillin (intravenous weeks then oral months, six to twelve total traditions) because fibrotic masses admit drug slowly, surgery for drainage, devitalised tissue and diagnosis rather than radical excision, tetracycline and clindamycin alternatives, IUCD removal in pelvic disease.
steps.say: Months of penicillin melt what surgery should only drain; remove the device, keep the organs.

left.title: Drug course
points: High dose penicillin G IV initial severe

right.title: Surgery role
points: Radical cancer surgery avoided when granules found preoperatively

steps.tx: **Culture difficulty** explains diagnostic reliance on histology: fastidious anaerobe, prior antibiotics, slow two week growth, commensal contamination from oral specimens, molar tooth colonies on brain heart agar, so tissue with granules and filament histology (Grocott and Gram) often convicts while cultures plead sterile.
steps.say: Send tissue, not swabs, and warn the laboratory to keep anaerobic plates for weeks.

left.title: Culture facts
points: Molar tooth or spider colonies slow
Mixed oral companions (Aggregatibacter actinomycetemcomitans named for it)

right.title: Histology facts
points: Filaments gram positive, acid fast negative

steps.tx: **Companion organisms** accompany Actinomyces from its mucosal home (Aggregatibacter, Eikenella, fusobacteria, streptococci), polymicrobial cultures expected and covered by the penicillin umbrella mostly. Their presence supports rather than confuses the diagnosis in the right tissue story. Molecular identification from tissue increasingly resolves cases where mixed oral flora otherwise obscures the filamentous culprit.
steps.say: Actinomyces travels with oral companions; mixed growth from a jaw sinus supports it.

right.title: Culture reading
points: Do not discard as oral contamination in tissue

steps.tx: **Dental prevention and prognosis** close: oral hygiene, caries treatment and extraction care prevent cervicofacial disease, relapse follows short therapy or retained devices, follow up imaging months. Actinomycosis rewards patience in both diagnosis and treatment, punishing rushed surgery and rushed antibiotics equally.
steps.say: Treat teeth, treat long, image late: actinomycosis punishes hurry twice.

right.title: Follow up
points: Relapse: re image, prolong therapy, seek device or tooth
Malignancy re excluded if course atypical

steps.tx: **Actinomyces versus Nocardia** is this module's filament fork: anaerobic non acid fast israelii versus aerobic partially acid fast Nocardia (next lesson), Gram branching shared, oxygen and acid fast deciding therapy (penicillin versus sulphonamides) before species names return. A Gram stain showing filaments should therefore trigger both oxygen requirements and acid-fast testing before treatment is narrowed.
steps.say: Branching filaments: anaerobic and acid fast negative takes penicillin, aerobic partial acid fast takes sulphonamide thinking.
